verdict.rationale: GitLab's own docs list a Personal access tokens feature, and the API docs tell users to authenticate with one, so the product ships its own access tokens. Nothing in the pack shows those tokens can be limited to specific repositories, scoped to particular permissions, or given an expiry date. missing for 10: documented per-repository/project token restriction, documented permission scopes, documented expiry-date setting, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can create fine-grained access tokens limited to specific repositories, permissions, and an expiry date
